title: Keep the text still as teaching appears
statement: Keep the passage still while teaching appears around it, reserving the space from the start, because text that shifts when modelling begins is jarring.
detail: A review of a Grade 3 reading build said that when the modelling starts and the text shifts left, it is jarring. The rebuild reserves the space the teaching will use from the beginning of the lesson, so the text never moves out from under the child. A later course standard accepts a student-facing checkpoint only when its layout remains stable as content is revealed, and lists layout shift among its failure signals.

layout remains stable as content is revealed.
Failure signals: Dense diagnostic panels; multiple primary actions; long passive blocks; layout shift; decorative complexity.
